about_en: Outside of research and building products, I enjoy travel, photography, and exploring everyday life in new places. My exchange semester in Freiburg, Germany, gave me new perspectives on how technology fits into real human experiences.
about_zh: 在研究與開發產品之外，我也喜歡旅行、攝影，以及探索不同城市的日常。德國弗萊堡的交換經驗讓我更常思考，科技如何真正融入人的生活。
